unit:
[Unit]
Description=GLM-5.3 UNCENSORED FP8 on vLLM
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
Group=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm
EnvironmentFile=/home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/api.env
Environment=HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
Environment=TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=8
Environment=NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0
Environment=VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=18,20,20,20
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/serve.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
TimeoutStopSec=120
LimitNOFILE=1048576
LimitMEMLOCK=infinity

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
launcher:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/.venv/bin:/home/ubuntu/.local/bin:$PATH"
export NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0
cd /home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm
export PYTHONPATH=/home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/custom-samplers-releases/20261002-041738/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH} # glm53-ordered-samplers
exec /home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/.venv/bin/vllm serve --config /home/ubuntu/glm53-vllm/server.yaml
